pip_requirements.description: Only the latest-release suite. requirements-test-floor.txt pins the oldest Home Assistant the blueprint supports, and raising that is a decision about who can use the blueprint, not an update.

customManagers.description: Version pins annotated with a `# renovate:` comment in the workflows and in packaging/release-pins.env. The annotation is the anchor; the same shape as the other SisyphusMD projects', so a pattern learned in one reads the same in all.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch, minor and digest updates once CI is green. The Home Assistant harness bump is the one that matters: CI runs the whole suite against the new release, so a green run is the evidence the blueprint still works on it.

The shared standard lives on the self-hosted Forgejo, so the gitea-tags datasource has to be told which host to ask. Held for review: packaging/refresh-pins.sh re-vendors the files on the branch, so the PR is complete, but a standard bump can change release machinery.
The shellcheck image pin is owned by the shared standard: it lives in the vendored packaging/shellcheck-all.sh, which the drift check forbids editing here. It arrives as a re-vendor instead.
